--Vedic metres as steeds of the sun's chariot;
1: भा. II. 6. 1; Vi. II. 8. 5.
as part of विष्णु.
2: Vi. V. 1. ३७; Br. I. 5. १९.
Seven in number--names given.
--a kind of temple with a number of towers. M. २६९. ३२ and ४९.

(I)--are ३३ Devas, constituting three ganas, याम, अजीतस् and शक्तस् with their chief Indra;
1: Br. II. १३. ९१.
drink the nectar of the moon until the चतुर्दशि, and on the पञ्चदशि the पितृस् drink of the rest.
2: वा. ५६. २५.
(II)--the gods of the चाक्षुष epoch; also known as साध्यस्. Br. III. 3. 9. [page१-618+ ३४]
--a सामग; सामन्स् in connection with the rituals in founding a new temple. भा. XII. 6. ५३; M. ९३. १३३; २६५. २८; वा. ८३. ५४.
--a देवगण; ३३ are distinguished among them. वा. ३१. 5.
--the chanting of the Vedas, being prac- tised in a hermitage. Br. III. २१. ४६.
